convertibility_reason: Uses only price action (MqlRates) with no custom indicators or external trading logic libraries. Simple entry/exit rules with fixed lot sizing. The Trade/SymbolInfo/DealInfo/PositionInfo .mqh includes are standard MT5 trade utility classes, not custom trading logic.

derived_values.name: up_1: count of bearish candles (close<open) in last N bars starting from bar [1]
derived_values.formula: count of R[i].close < R[i].open for i=0..N-1

derived_values.name: dn_1: count of bullish candles (close>open) in last N bars starting from bar [1]
derived_values.formula: count of R[i].close > R[i].open for i=0..N-1

derived_values.name: up_2: count of bars where absolute body size exceeds previous bar's absolute body size (bearish direction)
dn_2: count of bars where absolute body size exceeds previous bar's absolute body size (bullish direction)

other_exits: SignalCloseBuy and SignalCloseSell always return false - no signal-based exits, only SL/TP

position_sizing.conditional_logic: SolveLots always returns fixed Lots input value; comment mentions MaximumRisk works when Lots=0 but this logic is not implemented

custom_logic_notes: Strategy is a reversal/trend-exhaustion system: Opens BUY after N consecutive bearish candles (close<open) with each candle body larger than the previous (increasing body size). Opens SELL after N consecutive bullish candles (close>open) with increasing body size. The logic uses bar [1] through bar [N] (shifted by 1 from current), so signals are based on the last N completed bars. Buy entry requires no existing position, no sell signal, and no close-buy signal simultaneously. Sell entry has symmetric conditions. SignalCloseBuy and SignalCloseSell are stubs that always return false. Deviation for order execution is set to Sym.Spread()*3 points. The comment in Lots input mentions MaximumRisk but SolveLots ignores it and always returns fixed lots.
python_conversion_notes: Pure price-action strategy with no indicator handles needed. Logic is straightforward: count consecutive same-direction candles with growing bodies from the last N completed bars. Entry signals are simple equality checks (count == N, growth_count == N-1). SL/TP are fixed-point offsets from entry price. No digit adjustment logic present - SL/TP use _Point directly. The CSymbolInfo and CTrade wrappers can be replaced with direct broker API calls. Position check uses simple symbol-level select (single position per symbol). No partial close, no trailing, no martingale. The 'up' naming is counterintuitive: up_1 counts bearish candles (close<open), which is the BUY signal condition.
